en: Colorized historic postcard view of a street corner with a large multi‑story building labeled "Restaurant Hotel u. Ball-Säle Alberthof". The structure has a red-tiled roof, decorative gables, and a small tower with a dome. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk on a cobbled square, and a green electric tramcar passes in the foreground. Surrounding are additional town buildings and a slightly hilly, green background. The printed caption at the top identifies the location as Meißen and describes the hotel, ballrooms, and varieté theater "Alberthof".
